scenario_battle.score_definition: 20-bar signed movement / high-low range, bounded by tanh; not a calibrated probability

contract_quality.exercise_risk: Early exercise, assignment, dividends and settlement are not simulated

limitations: Fixed Greeks; no IV surface or rate/dividend model
Expiry intrinsic is hypothetical economic value, not a broker fill or exercise instruction
Modeled spread and slippage can understate actual losses

liquidity_trap.interpretation: Price/volume rejection proxy; no claim to observe hidden liquidity

limitations: Single provided option series; synthetic data is not market evidence
No capital sizing, assignment, overnight liquidity or contract rolling
Multiple-comparison bias and statistical significance not estimated

safety_supervisor.emergency_policy: Only reconciled, priced, owned reductions; unknown state blocks sending orders

limitations: Synthetic quotes and scores do not establish profitability or broker qualification.
Every module is read-only research; execution must independently recheck all mandatory risk gates.
Correlation uses owned cost plus pending buy commitments, not measured Greeks or a nonlinear portfolio model.
A displayed Call contract when scenarios conflict is illustrative, not an accepted entry.
Each saved snapshot is an independent immutable research journal; it is not a broker order.
Tournament uses a separately predefined fixed Call contract, five-minute synthetic UTC sessions, and no hindsight contract-chain selection.
No LLM, external network, account reconciliation or market observation refresh is performed.

counterfactual.limitations: Fixed 100 multiplier; hypothetical later quotes; no fill, liquidity or exercise guarantee
